description: Decode one transaction: block, sender, receiver, value, gas and fee, status, and the receipt logs with ERC-20 and ERC-721 transfers decoded (EVM via Etherscan; Solana via Helius). Partial while the receipt is not available; an unknown hash is an error (HTTP 404). Starter tier.

hash.description: Transaction hash (EVM 0x + 64 hex) or Solana signature.

name: get_tx
